about_the_game:
Deep in the ocean, 2 squid decide to open their own restaurant and are about to shake the industry. 

In Squidy and the Devourers, you play with a friend as squid and explore the entire sea floor to gather resources and recipes from all kinds of cultural regions. Learn about other restaurants and their culinary secrets, and diverse your menu from all regions, welcoming various clients all over the ocean! But just having different recipes can’t just be all.

You will have to communicate efficiently with your partner if you want to satisfy the clients. Take orders, cook, serve, learn new stories from clients. Deal with annoying or joyful clients, gourmet or casuals, design your restaurant however you want.

Wishlist Squidy and the Devourers to support us and get notified when the game releases!
